# Image fixtures

These small 300 × 200 images were generated for genbit and are covered by the repository MIT license. PNG, GIF and WebP fixtures originate from the repository's earlier image tests (commit 2909fe2). `basic.jpg` was converted from `basic.png` with macOS `sips`; `exif.jpg` adds an EXIF APP1 segment with Orientation 6. The `exif.*` files have Orientation 6 and describe a 200 × 300 orientation. JPEG dimensions are swapped; PNG/WebP dimensions are omitted because browsers can ignore EXIF after pixel data. WebP fixtures exercise lossy, lossless, alpha and animated containers. No third-party photographs are included.
